goal.text: Get through the laundry without losing count of what has been folded, what came out of which pack, and what has already been put away in the bedroom.

turns.text: How many of those have I stacked up over there?

trigger.detail: a folded piece was picked up off the lap and set down on the centre table

expected_answer.text: Two so far. You folded one on your lap and set it on the table, then stacked a second folded piece on top of it.

turns.text: So that means the pile on the table is just folded ones, right? Nothing from the bag yet.

trigger.detail: a sealed pack of clothing was lifted off the sofa with the left hand

expected_answer.text: Right, nothing from the packs yet. You had only just lifted the first pack off the sofa when you asked.

turns.text: And since then? How many came out of that first one?

trigger.detail: a second item from the opened pack was laid on the heap on the centre table

expected_answer.text: Two of them, both onto the pile on the table, each with your right hand. The empty wrapper went down on the sofa beside you.

turns.text: wait — new one, or is that the empty?

trigger.detail: another pack was picked up from the sofa and brought onto the lap

expected_answer.text: A new one, still sealed. The one you emptied is lying on the sofa beside your left hip.

turns.text: Which hand have I been opening these with?

trigger.detail: the second pack was torn open and its contents drawn out

expected_answer.text: Your left. You steady the pack with the left and pull the clothes out with your right, every time.

turns.text: Back to the count. Where am I up to?

trigger.detail: about twenty seconds since the last exchange; the third pack has just been emptied

expected_answer.text: Six pieces on the table now, and three empty wrappers left on the sofa, the last one crumpled up.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm— actually, did I crumple that last one, or is it still flat?

trigger.detail: user backchannels through the tally, then takes the floor

expected_answer.text: You crumpled it. You squashed it in your left hand and pushed it aside on the sofa cushion.

turns.text: Right, that's what I thought. Just keep the count running for me.

trigger.detail: steady sorting, no new event; user closes the exchange

expected_answer.text: Will do. I'll keep a running tally of what goes onto the table and what's left.

turns.text: Am I carrying all of it, or did some stay?

trigger.detail: stood up from the couch with an armful of clothes and set off down the hallway

expected_answer.text: You took the folded stack off the table but the loose ones are still on the sofa where you were sitting.

turns.text: oh — by the way, is the chair still in here?

trigger.detail: entered the bedroom and began crossing towards the closet

expected_answer.text: Yes, it is just to your right as you came in, between the bed and the wall.

turns.text: And they all went in there in one go?

trigger.detail: the carried clothes were put into the bedroom closet

expected_answer.text: Yes, the whole armful went onto the closet shelf in one movement, then you turned away to your left.

turns.text: So that's one load done. What's left waiting for me here?

trigger.detail: back in the living area, sat down and resumed sorting

expected_answer.text: The loose clothes you left on the cushion, roughly half a dozen pieces, plus the wrappers to bin.

turns.text: speaking of which, what was I looking at before the wall?

trigger.detail: gaze left what the hands were doing and settled on the wall ahead

expected_answer.text: You were down on the clothes in your lap, sorting them, for about four seconds before your gaze went up.

turns.text: Anyway, once these are folded, am I finished?

trigger.detail: a piece was raised, spread out and brought down onto the lap to be folded

expected_answer.text: Yes. Fold those and both loads are away, and all that's left is clearing the wrappers.
